title: GhastlyPixel9 Potions Deal
author: Gismun Lekti Se-Tremorapaki
pages:
[Librarian’s Note]
I bought this from a wandering trader who claims to have recovered this from a burning building. They state that the burning building resembled a lab. This seems important, so I’ll preserve this for future readers.
A Confederate Warlord, who calls themself Governor GhastlyPixel9 requested to buy 100 splash potions of Zombkolaps for 1,000 emeralds and 20 test subjects.

They also pledged to provide the 100 rotten flesh needed. Our lab accepted this deal, with the provision that the entirety of the transaction occurred upfront. The Governor reluctantly agreed to this provision.

Deal Evaluation from Head Researcher:
Our lab leadership evaluated this deal to be necessary to fund and expand experiments. This deal was amended by our ethics advisor, but objected to the final deal. Their objection is noted at the end.

Demand for Emeralds:
Our lab fundamentally lacks sufficiency. We need emeralds to buy food, cure materials, and construct emerald golems to protect our lab from attacks.

Our choices are binary, we can charge families more to cure their loved ones or we can make deals like this one. Diverting money from governors who will spend it on their wars regardless is more ethical in my eyes. Additionally, not being in their crosshairs allows us to continue our mission safely.

Ethics of Obtaining Test Subjects:
It is difficult to ethically obtain test subjects as patients often have families who do not consent to delays or experimentation.
Thus, receiving the 20 test subjects presents an opportunity to advance our lab’s research on emerging ways to fight Zombkolaps and other plagues.
While the likelihood of success is low, any probable increase to accomplishing our lab’s mission outweighs the individual lives of these test subjects.

Dissent from Ethics Advisor:
While all parties accepted my amendment for the test subjects being provided upfront, preventing the splash potions from enabling the payment, the deal does not satisfy my objections.

We do not know where this warlord got these test subjects from, but it was likely innocent civilians. Additionally, these potions are extremely dangerous, and can be used with massive destructive intent.
Entire villages can be wiped out with just a few of these. This deal will be a mistake.
CEO APPROVAL OF POTION USE: NOT REQUIRED
